title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt metrics + CI gating for prompt-set regressions
author: Ava Chen
release_notes:
Adds per-prompt metrics capture and CI gating for prompt-set regressions. Backwards compatible; opt-in via eval_harness.yml.
- New GH Action eval-metrics-check
- New eval-harness metrics exporter and comparator
- Updated docs: eval-harness CI guide
description:
Motivation: We need deterministic, per-prompt regression detection in CI so model or infra changes can't silently degrade prompt-level quality. This PR adds a per-prompt metrics pipeline, a comparator that computes delta against a baseline, and a CI gating action that fails the job if regressions exceed configured thresholds.

What changed (high level):
- eval-harness: add per_prompt_metrics exporter (JSONL) and comparator utils
- ci/: add github-actions/eval-metrics-check workflow that runs eval-harness on the PR model/version and compares to baseline stored in S3 (or mocked artifact for OSS)
- configs: introduce eval_harness.yml for per-repo thresholds and prompt-set mapping
- tests: unit tests for comparator logic + integration test using a pinned small model and a synthetic prompt-set
- docs: CI gating guide and example thresholds

Implementation notes:
- Metrics captured: per-prompt BLEU-like score (for tasks with references), per-prompt embedding-similarity, response-length-stability, and a generic quality_score from eval-harness evaluators. Each metric is emitted per-prompt and aggregated by the comparator.
- Comparator treats regressions as either absolute or relative based on config. Default gating: fail if >5% of prompts regress by more than 3% absolute in quality_score OR if mean quality_score drops >0.8%.
- CI action uses the baseline artifact uploaded to S3 (internal) or evaluates against the main branch artifact when available. For OSS repos a local baseline file in .github/eval-baselines/ is used.
- Rollout: feature gated by eval_harness.enable_per_prompt_metrics flag in eval_harness.yml. Default off for older repos.

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests added for comparator edge cases (NaNs, missing prompts, added/removed prompts).
- Integration GH Action run on this branch validated using a small synthetic prompt-set; CI passed.

Backward compatibility: The new flags are opt-in and do not change default eval-harness behavior. Existing repos without eval_harness.yml see no change.

Files changed (high-level):
- eval-harness/src/metrics/per_prompt_exporter.py: new exporter and writer (added ~250 LOC)

Ava Chen: Adjusted defaults and made thresholds configurable per-promptset. Marked for follow-up to tune by workload.

Ava Chen: Added regression-report artifact upload and expanded CI log messages.
